facts.text: Electric is performed by Katy Perry.
Artist: Katy Perry · Title: Electric · Album: Electric · Year: 2021 · Genre: Pop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2020's/Katy Perry - Electric.mp4
"Electric" is a song by American singer Katy Perry from the Pokémon 25 soundtrack album (2021).
It was released on May 14, 2021, by Capitol Records as the second single from the album.

It is an electropop ballad written by Perry, Jon Bellion, Lucas Marx, Rachel Kanner, Al Calderon, and the producers Jordan Johnson, Oliver "German" Peterhof and Stefan Johnson of the Monsters & Strangerz and Bruce Wiegner.

The American singer Katy Perry has released seven studio albums, one reissue, seven extended plays (EP), one compilation album, 43 singles (including four as featured artist), and 13 promotional singles.

According to the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), Perry is the fourteenth top digital singles artist in the United States, with 121.5 million digital singles and 19 million album units.
As of July 2024, she has a total of seven RIAA Diamond-certified records.
Teenage Dream is the third studio album by the American singer Katy Perry.
It was released on August 24, 2010, through Capitol Records and follows her second album One of the Boys (2008).
